CustomField.formula:
IF(
AND( Initiative_Achievement_Rollup__c >= 0.60, Initiative_Achievement_Rollup__c <= 0.69), "Did Not Meet Expectations",
IF( AND( Initiative_Achievement_Rollup__c >= 0.70, Initiative_Achievement_Rollup__c <= 0.79), "Met Some But Not All Expectations",
IF( AND( Initiative_Achievement_Rollup__c >= 0.80, Initiative_Achievement_Rollup__c <= 0.89), "Fully Met Expectations",
IF( AND( Initiative_Achievement_Rollup__c >= 0.90, Initiative_Achievement_Rollup__c <= 0.94), "Exceeded Expectations",
IF( AND( Initiative_Achievement_Rollup__c >= 0.95, Initiative_Achievement_Rollup__c <= 1), "Significantly Exceeded Expectations",
NULL)))))
CustomField.label: SMART Goal Achievement
